articulation.label: tomorrow
articulation.alt: tomorrow: /t/ → /ə/ → /m/ → /ɑ/ → /r/ → /oʊ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
